name: Can I perform hardware and functional adjustments myself, or do I need a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I perform hardware and functional adjustments myself, or do I need a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor adjustments, such as tightening a loose screw on a cabinet pull, can often be done by a homeowner. However, more complex adjustments involving door alignment, window sealing, or plumbing and electrical fixtures typically require the expertise of a professional. Improper adjustments can lead to further damage or compromise functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor adjustments can be DIY, but complex tasks like door alignment or plumbing adjustments are best left to professionals to avoid further issues.
